output.summary: Investigated both the _laReloadData soft-refresh loader and the separate boot-time loader/reseed IIFEs for pier_lic_types, pier_lic_classes, and pier_codes. Found the three stores carry hardcoded seed defaults and an unconditional boot-time reseed-when-empty step (:79712, :79729), unlike sb_bookings/sb_agents which have no seed data at all - so they follow the documented FL_DEFAULT_* seed pattern, not the sb_bookings/sb_agents pattern. Dropping the _laReloadData .length guard alone would not make 'clear stays cleared' true end-to-end (hard reload would still reseed) and would only create a new soft-refresh-vs-hard-reload inconsistency. Concluded the safer, evidence-supported option is to keep the guard and document it; added an explanatory comment at all three sites, no logic changed. Recorded the boot-time reseed inconsistency as a follow-up.

decisions: Keep the .length guard at all three _laReloadData sites unchanged; document the reasoning via inline comments rather than removing the guard.

Reasoning: removing the guard alone would not deliver 'clear stays cleared' end-to-end because the boot-time reseed IIFEs (:79712, :79729) independently revert an emptied pier_lic_types/pier_lic_classes/pier_codes list to seed on every hard reload regardless of this guard; a partial fix would only create a new soft-refresh-vs-hard-reload inconsistency.

These three stores follow the documented FL_DEFAULT_* seed-only-when-empty pattern (CLAUDE.md section 2), not the sb_bookings/sb_agents no-seed pattern, which supports the guard being an intentional (if previously undocumented) consequence of that pattern rather than a bug to silently drop.
risks: The underlying inconsistency (a deliberate user clear of pier_codes/pier_lic_classes still reverts to seed on the next hard reload) remains unresolved - it is now documented, not fixed, per the ticket's explicit fallback instruction for genuinely unsettled evidence.

followUps: Consider a dedicated ticket to change the boot-time reseed IIFEs for pier_lic_types/pier_lic_classes/pier_codes (:79712, :79729) to distinguish 'key absent from the blob (fresh install)' from 'key present and empty (user deliberately cleared it)', so a deliberate clear survives both soft refresh and hard reload consistently, matching the sb_bookings/sb_agents rule end-to-end.
rollback: git revert the commit on this branch, or manually strip the added comment text back to the original three lines at :41597, :41598, :41601 - no logic changes to undo.
